phenomenon_summary: The all-or-none membrane voltage spike that emerges from the nonlinear, voltage-dependent gating of sodium and potassium ion channels in a neuronal membrane patch.

units.name: stimulus_current
units.description: External depolarizing current injected into the membrane patch.

units.name: synaptic_input
units.description: Ligand-gated channel current from upstream synapses.

units.name: Nav_m_gate
units.description: Activation gate of voltage-gated Na+ channel; opens rapidly with depolarization.

units.name: Nav_h_gate
units.description: Inactivation gate of Na+ channel; closes slowly with depolarization.

units.name: Nav_pore
units.description: Effective Na+ conductance (product of m and h gate states).

units.name: Kv_n_gate
units.description: Activation gate of delayed-rectifier K+ channel; opens slowly with depolarization.

units.name: Kv_pore
units.description: Effective K+ conductance from delayed rectifier channels.

units.name: leak_channel
units.description: Passive leak conductance setting resting potential.

units.name: Na_current
units.description: Inward Na+ current driven by gradient and Nav conductance.

units.name: K_current
units.description: Outward K+ current driven by gradient and Kv conductance.

units.name: membrane_capacitance
units.description: Integrates net current into a voltage change across the lipid bilayer.

units.name: membrane_voltage
units.description: Transmembrane potential Vm; the state variable that gates channels.

units.name: spike_output
units.description: Detected action potential: the emergent all-or-none voltage spike propagated downstream.

interactions.description: Sustained depolarization slowly closes inactivation gate.
Depolarization slowly opens K+ activation gate.
Conductance times driving force gives I_Na.
Conductance times driving force gives I_K.
Leak current pulls Vm toward rest.
Inward Na+ further depolarizes — positive feedback core of the spike.
Outward K+ repolarizes — negative feedback that terminates the spike.
Threshold crossing is read out as an action potential.
Post-spike inactivation enforces the refractory period.

parameters.name: g_Na_max
parameters.role: Maximum sodium conductance — sets spike amplitude and excitability.

parameters.name: g_K_max
parameters.role: Maximum potassium conductance — controls repolarization speed.

parameters.name: stimulus_amplitude
parameters.role: Drives the system above or below firing threshold.

notes: Hodgkin–Huxley-style abstraction. The action potential emerges from a fast positive-feedback loop (Vm → Nav_m → Na_current → Vm) bounded by two slower negative-feedback loops (Nav inactivation and Kv activation). Multiscale hierarchy: gates → channels → membrane patch → neuron.
